subject.title: fix(apps): restore live session updates after native reconnects

question: Should this maintainer-labeled cross-platform reconnect fix proceed once the exact head has completed native CI and demonstrates live session recovery after a real reconnect on the affected clients?
rationale: The PR changes lifecycle-sensitive observer declarations across three native applications; approving the intended reconnect semantics and their platform coverage requires maintainer judgment beyond static review.

options.title: Require native proof and CI
options.body: Request a redacted Android, iOS, or macOS reconnect trace that shows live updates resume, then review completed platform CI for the exact PR head.

options.title: Accept test-only evidence
options.body: Merge based on focused regression tests and static checks while accepting the remaining device-level behavior uncertainty.

options.title: Narrow the scope
options.body: Split one or more platform implementations into smaller PRs if joint cross-platform lifecycle review is too costly.

recommendation.title: Require native proof and CI
recommendation.body: Request a redacted Android, iOS, or macOS reconnect trace that shows live updates resume, then review completed platform CI for the exact PR head.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor authored the current cross-platform implementation and can supply the requested after-fix native evidence; broader current-main ownership was not independently verifiable here.
